bayts.text: The Everlasting (Al-Bāqī, Allah) has shielded me from Satan during my passage (along the road of exile) and in the homelands.
My worship I began in the name of God, and He has sufficed me against those given over to idle pastimes.
I have turned all praise and all thanksgiving to the King (Al-Mālik), the All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), the Appreciative (Ash-Shakūr).
The Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm) has slain my stoned (demon) through the Prophet (Muḥammad), his Family and his Companions, the stars.
By (the grace of) God I parted from the Nazarenes (the Christian colonisers) at Djéwol (Jéwol), and from all that is other than Him, decisively, taking nothing (from them).
To the Prophet (Muḥammad) I once turned, at Ndar (Saint-Louis), that which sufficed me against the enemies, like dregs.
To the Chosen One (Muḥammad) I turned, at Ndakaaru (Dakar), a remembrance (of praise) by which the deceiver was flung headlong.
To the Elect (Al-Mujtabā, Muḥammad) I once turned, aboard the ship, a praise that will abide forever in Medina.
I made my service pure, at Conakry, for the Chosen One (Muḥammad), the Effacer (Al-Māḥī), without any blameworthy deed.
Once, at Grand-Bassam (Karambasā), my challenger fled from me, and was held back far off, towards others than me.
The King (Al-Mālik) gave me possession, at Dāwum (Dahomey), of what sufficed me against the haggling enemies.
The Bestower of benefit (An-Nāfiʿ) has benefited me at Libreville with that for which every Saint holds me in holy envy.
To the Prophet (Muḥammad) I once turned, at Bāfali (in Gabon), that by which my gathering was illumined.
To the Chosen One (Muḥammad) I turned, at Kablabisā (Cap Lopez), that which sufficed me against an enemy, who was held back (far off).
At Kalwā (in Gabon) it weighed upon Satan that I am the Servant (Khadīm) of him (Muḥammad) who sufficed me against trial.
God drives every harm forever towards others than me: there is no god but God.
The sacred circling (aṭ-ṭawāf) of whoever has denied me will never be accepted with the Divinity (Allah) and the Prophet (Muḥammad).
Towards others than me (be driven) whoever does not love me, and away from God, the Most High, the Bringer into being.
The Everlasting (Allah), who has granted me the privileges of the great, has driven towards others than me whoever grew proud.
Towards others than me and towards others than the Chosen One (Muḥammad) (let him go) who does not love me, and let him meet what he did not guard against.
Towards other than my Lord and other than the Elect (Al-Muntajab, Muḥammad) is driven whoever has turned away from me and kept aloof.
I have repelled the enemies of the Divinity (Allah) and of the Prophet (Muḥammad), and whoever hates me never ceases to be a sinner.
Through my Guide (the Prophet) (my way) was fulfilled and my sale (of the soul to God) was profitable; and towards others than me (turned) every dog that barked.
He who opposed me will regret it in the two abodes (this world and the Hereafter), by the justice of the Everlasting (Allah), whose grace has guided me.
From what is not gladness and from Satan I have been shielded by Him (Allah) who generously granted me the homelands (the return).
